bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · slipped below the 100-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 跌破 100 日均线

read.en: Nvidia fell 4.4% on Oct 22 to $212.21, trading between $211.26 and $218.88. It is below the falling 5-day ($216.4), 10-day ($220.5) and 30-day ($224.3) averages and now the rising 100-day ($214.5), and above the rising 200-day ($203.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($233.35), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 英伟达 10月22日下跌 4.4%，收于 $212.21，盘中区间 $211.26–218.88。股价位于下行的 5 日（$216.4）、10 日（$220.5）和 30 日均线（$224.3）下方，并跌破上行的 100 日均线（$214.5），仍在上行的 200 日均线（$203.6）上方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，且在零轴之下；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$233.35），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The drop broke the 100-day average and the $212.8 Oct 15 and Oct 20 lows, both now resistance. Resistance is $212.8–214.5, then $216.4–218.9 (5-day, Oct 22 high) and $220.5–224.3 (10 and 30-day). Support is $211.3 (Oct 22 low), then $207.3–208.9 (Aug 24 and Sep 14 lows) and $203.6 (200-day). A close below $207 would open $203.6; a close above $214.5 would target $218.9.
